name: Menu
notes: The first screen. It loads the saved progress (which monsters are unlocked, the last pick), then the MONSTER SURVIVAL logo drops in over the meadow and bounces twice, a white flash, then the monster picker appears: Left / Right browse the 9 monsters (each slides in and cries), START begins the run with it. Only Furrbit (Normal) is playable at first; every won run unlocks the next monster in the roster, and the locked ones show as dark silhouettes. SELECT asks whether to clear the saved progress. Coming back from a run, the last pick is still selected.
